svg.aria-label: MODEL 2204 · BOARD LAYOUT (DERIVED) — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Marshall model 2204 STD factory drawing, sheets 2204PRE.DGM (iss 4, 19-5-88) and 2204PWR.DGM (iss 2, 18-6-89) — layout derived from these schematics; no factory layout drawing located, and the circuit is built on the JM80 printed board — not a trace
T1 — Marshall 1202-324 · 240/220/120 V primary · HT + 6.3 V heaters
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
